For more information see our Privacy StatementNewsHow to Watch the 2026 Masters TournamentBy Nick Pietruszkiewicz| Thursday, April 09, 2026It is Thursday at the 2026 Masters, and the competition begins at the 90th edition of the Tournament, April 9-12. Among the storylines at this year's Masters, Rory McIlroy is looking to defend his dramatic 2025 victory, and Scottie Scheffler sets sights on a third Green Jacket. A global audience will be able to immerse itself in the Tournament across multiple platforms.In addition to thorough coverage through the Masters App and Masters.com – On The Range, Amen Corner, Featured Groups and more – the Masters will be delivered with multiple viewing options across social, digital and linear properties.Debuting this year will be Inside Amen Corner, a dedicated feed on Prime Video that will offer a stats-enhanced viewing experience and feature an in-depth look into the strategy behind playing Hole Nos. 11, 12 and 13.See the full 2026 Tournament Schedule here, and
